system.title: System & Poller

system.pollTriggered: Poll cycle triggered — statuses/metrics refresh in a few seconds.

ftp.title: FTP Server
ftp.desc: Destination for sending/storing backups and exports.
ftp.pwSet: Already set — fill in to change.

saved: Saved and confirmed on the server at {{time}}.

plan.title: Organization plan
plan.canceledNote: Plan canceled — access continues until {{date}}. After that, new items are blocked.
plan.canceledNoDate: Plan canceled. With no expiration date, access continues until the Master sets one.
plan.expiredNote: Plan expired. You can't create new devices/users until you renew. Existing data stays intact.
plan.cancelMsg: Your {{name}} plan stays active for all organization users until the expiration date. After that, no new devices or users can be added — no data is lost. Do you want to proceed with the cancellation?
plan.noOrgAdmin: Only organization admins manage the plan here.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.intro: Critical, irreversible actions for your company. Proceed with care.
danger.deleteHint: Removes {{name}} and ALL of its data. This action cannot be undone.

modal.title: Delete company permanently
modal.irreversible: You are about to permanently delete the company {{name}} and all of its records. This operation is IRREVERSIBLE — the data cannot be recovered afterward.
modal.planWarnTitle: Your company has an active plan ({{plan}}).
modal.planWarnBody: Deleting the data is NOT the same as canceling the subscription. If you only want to end the plan, use the Plans tab. Deleting the company removes the plan link along with all other data.
modal.plusMore: Also: racks, controllers, API keys, webhooks, templates, audit history and Copilot conversations.
modal.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the company name ("{{name}}") or the word EXCLUIR:
